REBOUNDOPS / LOCAL DEVELOPER PREVIEW

Data and backups

Understand memory-only sessions, explicit local saving and the records you need to back up separately.

On this pageKnow the defaultsBack up before stopping or upgradingOpt into local savingDelete copies deliberately

Know the defaults

Recovery sessions live in API memory by default and disappear when that process stops. Both interfaces support JSON backup and restore, saved-session resume and opt-in disk saving. My next step links to the full recovery interface for detailed evidence and check-ins.

Back up before stopping or upgrading

From Start or My next step, download a JSON backup to preserve a restorable recovery session. Export Markdown for a readable summary; it is not a restorable backup. Store downloads privately outside Git. Restoring JSON creates a memory-only session; saving must be enabled again explicitly.

Opt into local saving

REBOUNDOPS_DATA_DIR="$HOME/.reboundops/sessions" npm run dev

The launcher configures ${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/reboundops/sessions outside Git; override it with REBOUNDOPS_DATA_DIR when needed. Configuring a folder never saves answers automatically. Choose Save on this computer in the workspace, or in the full recovery interface choose Enable local disk saving for this session. Configuring the folder alone does not save a session. After restarting, use Resume session to reopen an opted-in record.

Saved sessions and downloaded backups are plaintext, not encrypted by the app. Use a private device and disk encryption. Never commit résumés, session files or provider keys. Run only one API process against a data folder.

Delete copies deliberately

Deleting a saved session removes its in-memory record and saved session file. Turning saving off removes its disk copy but keeps the session in memory. Downloaded backups, schema-upgrade backups and other copies require separate deletion.

Workspace records need a separate private backup of the files you use; recovery exports do not include them. Read saving and recovery details ↗ and privacy guidance ↗ before using personal data. If saved files are skipped, stop the API and make a private copy before investigating; do not publish the files in an issue.
